claims.assertion: Gosia’s lesson describes the Federation as a physical, multiracial organization founded by Andromedans, Arcturians, and Lyrians after the Great Expansion from Lyra.
claims.speaker: Gosia (lesson; presenting Mari Swa’s account)
claims.qualifiers: She says it coordinates alliances and rules.

claims.assertion: Gosia says Federation authority over Earth is layered, with local politics at Viera behind the Moon and higher system decisions extending to Saturn.
claims.speaker: Gosia (lesson)
claims.qualifiers: She says lower levels often lack knowledge of higher-level activity.

claims.assertion: Gosia says the Federation views Earth incarnates as avatars for offworld souls seeking intense, constrained experiences, and supervises that setting.
claims.speaker: Gosia (lesson, describing Federation claims)
claims.qualifiers: She says the account includes soul choice and manipulated conditions.

claims.assertion: Gosia portrays the Federation as non-monolithic: many local members are benevolent, while hidden upper levels lack transparency and may hold conflicting interests.
claims.speaker: Gosia (lesson)
claims.qualifiers: She says the organization resists a simple good-or-bad judgment.
